title: Derived base change for a relatively flat module
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism of schemes,
and let $\mathcal G$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module flat
over $S$. For every $g:T\to S$, derived pullback gives an isomorphism

$$
Lg^*Rf_*\mathcal G\;\cong\;Rf_{T,*}\mathcal G_T.
$$

proof.text: Apply the existing canonical theorem lem-pc-relatively-flat-canonical-module-base-change in universe u, choosing the Grothendieck derived-category instance for every scheme. The tensor pullback is a left adjoint, hence right exact and additive. The canonical theorem gives an invertible morphism from Lg* Rf*(G[0]) to Rf_T*((p*G)[0]); apply asIso. Its proof retains the finite affine Cech route of this node, with the same relative-flatness hypotheses, arbitrary base change and no nonemptiness assumption.

Compare each given scheme-derived category with the fixed small category DerivedCategory X.Modules by schemeDerivedCategoryEquiv. Compatibility with Q identifies single objects. For direct image, choose a complex preimage P of the input, resolve it by the functorial K-injective replacement I(P), and compute both direct images from the same quasi-isomorphism P to I(P). The Q-compatibility isomorphism identifies the results. For pullback, derivedPullback_def is exactly transport of Scheme.Modules.derivedPullback through these equivalences, and the equivalence counit gives its object comparison.

Transport the isomorphism of the first step to the fixed module-derived categories using the second-step source and target comparisons. For the original four HasDerivedCategory instances in arbitrary universe w, construct those same comparisons to the fixed model. Compose the source comparison, the fixed-model base-change isomorphism and the inverse target comparison, and use the fully faithful equivalence functor preimageIso to obtain the required isomorphism. No uniform HasDerivedCategory instance in universe w is added to the statement.
